name: seo-platform
description: Multi-company web app (React + TypeScript) in front of the SEO Agent n8n workflows

scripts.build: npm run build -w @seo/web && npm run build -w @seo/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @seo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @seo/server && npm run typecheck -w @seo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @seo/shared && npm run test -w @seo/server
